title: derris benthamii
intro: Derris benthamii, commonly known as Tinospora cordifolia, is a plant native to tropical regions of Asia. It is a perennial climber with several health benefits, including the ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and alleviate symptoms of diabetes and anxiety. The therapeutic actions of Tinospora cordifolia include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
